title: ever SAPHIR|Women's A-Line Sequin Leaf Maxi Prom Dress with Sleeves
descriptionHtml:
Featuring a classic round neckline, short ruffle sleeves and a belt design in the waist, this prom dresses with sleeves is perfect for any special occasions. This maxi prom dress with flowy tulle skirt will make you comfortable when wearing it at your prom night. The shimmery leave design also gives a romantic vibe. The sequin bodice prom dress is perfect for parties, cocktail, prom, homecoming, graduation, weddings, and any other formal affair!

Sleeveless Fishtail Version:Evening Maxi Dress


Short-Sleeve Fishtail Version:Prom Dress


Cap Sleeve Version:Evening Gowns


Fit: Please refer to size chart.

Length: Floor length.

Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.

Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.

Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.

Fabric: The garment comprises sequin.

Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
